tool_selection.reasoning: SHAP provides a game-theoretic attribution score to quantify how much mean smoothness contributes to the prediction, offering insight into its impact on the benign class. Sensitivity analysis directly simulates masking by replacing the feature with zero (or mean) and measuring the prediction shift, which is the most direct test of what happens when the feature is masked. Together, these tools deliver both interpretability and experimental validation of prediction change under feature ablation in tabular data.
